note: Location question - should match 'I'm on my way', 'I'll be there shortly', etc.
Driver update - rider should get 'No worries, take your time', 'I'll wait for you'
Traffic message - should match 'No worries', 'Take your time'
Empty message - should always return empty list
Flagged message - caller discards suggestions, not SmartReplier's concern
Driver arrived - rider should get 'Coming down now', 'Be right there'
Positive feedback - driver reply 'Glad I could help', 'Have a great day'
